name: Access to justice
description: Effective courts, legal aid and fair proceedings so people can obtain remedies for violations.

name: Asylum-seekers - refugees
description: Protection of people fleeing persecution, covering asylum procedure, non-refoulement and reception conditions.

name: Business and human rights
description: Corporate duty to respect human rights, due diligence, and remedy for business-caused harms.

name: CP rights - general
description: Umbrella label covering the whole field of civil and political rights across all its topics.

name: Civil society
description: Protection of non-state actors who promote human rights, including activists, unions and watchdogs.

name: Corruption
description: Integrity of public institutions and officials, and freedom from governance corrupted by bribery.

name: Death penalty
description: Abolition of capital punishment and safeguards around sentencing and execution of death sentences.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Detention
description: Conditions of custody, arrest and pretrial confinement, and safeguards against unlawful detention.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Disability rights
description: Equal enjoyment of rights by persons with disabilities, accessibility, and independent living.

name: Discrimination
description: Elimination of unfair distinctions between people on any ground, in law and in practice.

name: ESC rights - general
description: Umbrella label covering the whole field of economic, social and cultural rights across all its topics.

name: Elections
description: Free and fair elections, political participation, and genuine representation of the people.

name: Enforced disappearances
description: Cases of people vanishing at the hands of state agents, and the duty to investigate and disclose fate.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Environment and human rights
description: Right to a healthy environment and state and business duties on pollution and climate harm.

name: Extrajudicial executions
description: Unlawful killings by state agents or others acting with impunity, and accountability for them.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Freedom of assembly
description: Peaceful gathering by individuals and groups, and the state duty to protect it.
parent: Freedom of expression, association and belief

name: Freedom of association and peaceful assembly
description: Right to form and join groups and to gather peacefully without unjustified interference.
parent: Freedom of expression, association and belief

name: Freedom of movement
description: Liberty to travel, reside and choose one's place of residence within a country's territory.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Freedom of opinion and expression
description: Freedom to hold opinions, seek and spread information, and criticize government without censorship.
parent: Freedom of expression, association and belief

name: Freedom of religion and belief
description: Free practice, teaching and change of religion, and protection against religious intolerance.
parent: Freedom of expression, association and belief

name: Freedom of the press
description: Independent journalism, access to information, and protection of journalists from interference.
parent: Freedom of expression, association and belief

name: Gender-based violence
description: Prevention and response to violence targeting women, girls and other genders, and prosecution of perpetrators.

name: General
description: Catch-all for recommendations that do not fit into any more specific topic of this taxonomy.

name: HIV - Aids
description: Protection of people living with HIV, access to treatment, and freedom from HIV-related discrimination.

name: Human rights and terrorism
description: Safeguards against abuses committed in the name of countering terrorism, including detention and profiling.

name: Human rights defenders
description: Protection of people who defend human rights against threats, attacks and intimidation.

name: Human rights education and training
description: Teaching human rights in schools, universities and public bodies to build awareness and capacity.

name: Human rights violations by state agents
description: Abuses committed by officials acting for the state, and the duty to prevent and punish them.

name: Impunity
description: Failure to investigate and punish violations, and measures to end the impunity of perpetrators.

name: Indigenous peoples
description: Rights of indigenous communities to land, self-determination, culture and participation in decisions.

name: Internally displaced persons
description: Rights of people forced to flee their homes within their own country, including return and aid.

name: International humanitarian law
description: Rules of armed conflict protecting civilians, wounded combatants and detained persons during hostilities.

name: International instruments
description: Adoption, ratification and implementation of the core international human rights treaties.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: Justice
description: Fair, impartial legal institutions and processes that deliver due process and remedy.

name: Labour rights
description: Fair working conditions, freedom of association, and protection from forced or exploitative labour.

name: Migrants
description: Rights of people moving across borders, including admission, work and integration conditions.

name: Minority rights
description: Equal treatment and participation of ethnic, religious and linguistic minority groups.

name: National Human Rights Institution
description: Establishment and operation of a national human rights institution with independence and a mandate.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: National action plan
description: National policies and plans that implement human rights commitments across government.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: Other
description: Residual label for recommendations that fit none of the specified topics in this taxonomy.

name: Poverty
description: Adequate standard of living, social protection, and measures to reduce poverty and inequality.

name: Privacy
description: Protection of personal data, private life, home and communications from arbitrary surveillance.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Public security
description: Law enforcement conduct, public order measures and state security practices that infringe rights.

name: Racial discrimination
description: Elimination of racial prejudice and unequal treatment in law, services and public life.

name: Right to development
description: Participation in and benefit from economic and social progress, and conditions favourable to it.

name: Right to education
description: Free, inclusive and quality primary and secondary education for every child.

name: Right to food
description: Access to adequate, safe and nutritious food, and freedom from hunger.

name: Right to health
description: Access to affordable, timely and quality health services and medical care.

name: Right to housing
description: Adequate, affordable and secure housing, and protection against forced eviction.

name: Right to land
description: Secure land tenure, protection from arbitrary dispossession, and fair land registration.

name: Right to life
description: Protection against arbitrary deprivation of life and the duty to protect persons from threats.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Right to water and sanitation
description: Access to safe drinking water and adequate sanitation, with dignity and affordability.

name: Rights for older people
description: Equal enjoyment of rights by older persons, including care, social security and participation.

name: Rights of the Child
description: Protection of children from harm, and their care, education, health and participation rights.

name: SDGs
description: Alignment of policies and funding with the Sustainable Development Goals and human rights commitments.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity
description: Equal rights and non-discrimination for people of any sexual orientation or gender identity.

name: Sexual and reproductive rights
description: Access to contraception, safe abortion, maternal care, and freedom from sexual violence.

name: Special procedures
description: Country-specific mechanisms, rapporteurs and working groups examining particular human rights situations.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: Statelessness and the right to nationality
description: Prevention of statelessness and the right to acquire, retain and change nationality.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Technical assistance and cooperation
description: Capacity building and peer support provided to states to implement their human rights commitments.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: Torture and other CID treatment
description: Prohibition of torture and cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment in any setting.
parent: Liberty and security of the person

name: Trafficking
description: Prevention of trafficking in persons, protection of victims, and prosecution of traffickers.

name: Transitional justice
description: Measures addressing past abuses, including truth, reparations, prosecutions and institutional reform.

name: Treaty Bodies
description: Monitoring of state compliance with ratified treaties by expert committees in the treaty system.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: UPR process
description: Peer review of states' human rights records, covering reporting, dialogue and follow-up.
parent: The review process, institutions and international framework

name: Violent extremism and human rights
description: Responses to violent extremism that respect human rights, in prevention, prosecution and detention.

name: Women's rights
description: Equality and empowerment of women in law, political life, work and the family.

name: Youth rights
description: Rights and participation of adolescents and young people in education, work and civic life.
